title: Big Block Wars Multiplayer RTS
author: potaten2015
selftext:
Hi All!

Fable, Opus, Astra, and I have been working on Big Block Wars. I grew up playing the Age-like games (Age of Mythology + Empires) and really wanted to capture that core gameplay loop, but make it more approachable to anyone. I've been dogfooding with myself, my fiance, and some close friends, and we've been enjoying it a lot!

My favorite AI assisted feature here is actually the video I linked above. I recorded my voice walkthrough and asked Opus 5.5 to create the video that goes behind it. It handled cleaning up the audio, converted the audio to text with timestamps, checked for natural transition points, and then created the entire video.

For actual dev, I have a decent development cycle for most projects now. 

* Create a file directory with CLAUDE.md, VISION.md, and a PLAN directory
* Start with a VISION.md file that has feelings, justification, and broad stroke descriptions of game mechanics and inspiration
* In CLAUDE.md describe the workflow that the agents should go through. For me, that's:
   * Break the the project into discrete steps
   * For each step, use an agent to:
      * Write a plan phase into the PLAN directory
      * Adversarial review the plan
      * Repeat until perfect
      * Implement the plan
      * Adversarially review the implementation (including play testing)
      * Repeat until perfect

I've found that it provides the LLM a history of past steps taken, but they are discrete, so if the bot needs context it can check one shorter file instead of a single massive file. You could use your version control for this, but I think the markdown native readable files are also great if you need to review the generated implementation plans as well.

That's all I really have. Pretty simple game but worth checking out. Definitely open to questions here about the development, or feedback on the game!
